notes.title: July Update | New content and Bug fixing
notes.content:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1059893584431693844/1263866003004067891/image.png?ex=669bca70&is=669a78f0&hm=e5d5ee5280dab99ec4c946da405a52f1baab6fac56055801c25269532aa0c4de&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=548&height=350

Hello everyone :)

This updates introduce the additional content to the mannequins 
Which is a way to escape :D!
Every *Power of 10 rounds, you will have the option to escape the hotel, in this way you will be counted as a winner, otherwise dying will results a lose.
The escape option will be at the front door and need the vote of all players, so you have to discuss with your team if you want to continue burning parts or escape.
And don't worry, all mannequins will be in sleeping mode (idle) at that round so no pressure :)
Until you burn the next part, this will mean you decided to continue burning parts, and mannequins will be activated.

This update also includes some bug fixing which can be listed as below:
Juwaira: 

 Dead players can trigger Juwaira using in-game voice


Mannequins:

 Enhancements on the Mannequins mechanics to avoid bugs
 FIxed climbing glitch to above the map



Hope you Enjoy the game :)
- Nawaf

notes.title: April Update - تحديث ابريل | Hajis - هاجس
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373114/68616239922df305e19470a3003d87785f6efaaf.png

Hello Everyone :)

This update includes many changes and new content to the game.

MAIN MENU enhancement:

 Enhanced Main Menu UI controls.
 Enhanced the Missions selection.
 Enhanced the Regions selection.
 Sorted and better displayed lobbies.
 Teaser of the new mission "Mannequins.


ADDITIONAL REVIVING SYSTEM:
You can now look for team reviving scrolls which can be help the players when they all die to repeat the latest floor they died in instead of starting from the beginning, although the team revive scrolls are very limited (Max of 2 scrolls per game)

Proximity Voice Chat
The proximity voice chat is back now to the game :D !
Juwaira can also be triggered by your local voice as well so becareful! :)
You can hear your teammates when they are near or when using the walkie-talkie.

Juwaira modification
Juwaira now are faster by 50% in all floors.


Hope you like the latest update, 
Enjoy :). 

- Nawaf

notes.title: Mastering update for HAJIS
notes.content:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1041987515382497415/1048292286439637002/thum1b.png

Hello all :),



Due to a lot of feedback I had, regarding bugs and game concepts, I've been working to cover all the elements that were missing and fixing many bugs in HAJIS.



The game has now been changed in several ways, such as:

- Juwaira can no longer listen to and hear vocal voice in-game. Instead she can hear everything else now (footsteps, doors, drawers, equipment, objectives etc)

- Doors now can be opened/closed to add triggers to Juwaira

- Juwaira is 50% faster on all floors

- The doll's riddles are now much simpler, so you have to only find 1 missing doll and place it on the gold stand.

- Faint lights added to Prayer beads + Red eyes

- The game can now be playable solo 1-4

- Juwaira's belongings can be stacked now



and the fixed bugs are:

- Items dropped from the map

- Items stuck under ashes (dead player)

and some other small bugs fixed



I will keep updating the game to add more content and fix more bugs we may find. You can join the discord server to report any additional bugs you may find https://discord.gg/R8BySEKFhh.



Hope you enjoy :)
